# RaceNode

> RaceNode is racing team management software: crew planning, race weekend management, crew travel and accommodation, and the team's race weekend timetable, in one place. It is web-based and has iOS and Android apps. Free for all racing teams until 31 December 2026, every module and every team member included.

RaceNode is made for motorsport teams (GT, endurance, single-seater and other championships) and the people who run them: team managers, logistics coordinators, engineers, mechanics and drivers. It covers people logistics (who travels how, who sleeps where), not freight. Teams sign up and try it on their own; no demo call is required. Data is hosted in the EU. Publisher: WBLT Engineering (France).

## Modules

- [Management](https://www.racenode.com/management/): race weekend and crew management. Crew assignments and roles per car, racecar entries, team structure and meals for every event.
- [Planning](https://www.racenode.com/crew-planning/): crew planning and season scheduling. Who works which race across the season, crew availability, rotas and staffing, connected to every event on the calendar. Each team member sees their own season, role, travel, hotel, meals and next sessions in the Me view, on their phone. Free for every team member.
- [Logistics](https://www.racenode.com/logistics/): crew travel and accommodation. Flights, trucks, rental vans, hotels and room allocation for every race weekend, with what is still missing before the event. Bookings can be created from a confirmation document (PDF, mail file, picture, spreadsheet), checked in a preview before anything is saved.
- [Timetable](https://www.racenode.com/timetable/): race weekend timetable and schedule. The team's schedule built around the official timetable, recurring briefings, a live countdown and an iCal feed shared with the whole team. The official sessions can be filled in from the organizer's timetable (PDF, spreadsheet, calendar file), checked in a preview before anything is saved.

## Motorsport calendar

- [Motorsport calendar](https://www.racenode.com/calendar/): the race calendars of the championships in the RaceNode catalog on one page, filterable by discipline, region and month, with one page per championship (https://www.racenode.com/calendar/<championship>/). Dates and circuits as each organizer publishes them, with a link to the official page; when next season is not published yet, the page says so and shows the last season known.

## Pricing and availability

- [Pricing](https://www.racenode.com/pricing/): RaceNode is free until a team's first event is over (an event can also be a test). Then €99 per month excl. VAT, or €990 excl. VAT for 12 months from the date of payment. No payment before 1 January 2027. All modules, for the whole team; 2027 prices. Planning (Me view) is free for every team member.
- [App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6804234080) and [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.racenode.app).
- Web app: https://app.racenode.com
